alignment_reasoning: The image fails significantly on class alignment. The target class is 'barracouta', but the generated fish exhibits traits of a Northern Pike (single dorsal fin, large scales, different jaw structure). Only 3 out of 9 checkpoints passed (Eyes, Body Shape, Forked Tail). The fine_grained_classifier predicted 'barracouta' with high confidence, likely due to the general 'long fish' shape, but this contradicts the detailed anatomical evidence verified by the Router. This is a case of semantic hallucination where the model generated a plausible-looking fish that is taxonomically incorrect.
